info.description:
Hedra API v3 provides managed multimodal inference with a shared prepaid API wallet. Use the [vision and reasoning quickstart](https://www.hedra.com/docs/pages/developer/v3/quickstart) for supported image-understanding and language models through POST /v3/chat/completions. The language API also exposes POST /v3/responses and POST /v3/anthropic/v1/messages compatibility routes.

Image, video, and audio generation use asynchronous jobs: submit to POST /v3/models/{model}, then follow status and retrieve outputs. See the [model-job quickstart](https://www.hedra.com/docs/pages/developer/v3/model-jobs). Each model defines its supported inputs and outputs; inspect GET /v3/models/{model} before integrating.

Create an [API key](https://www.hedra.com/develop/api-keys) and fund the [API wallet](https://www.hedra.com/develop/billing). Studio subscription credits are separate. Direct requests accept Key or Bearer authentication; language-model requests require chat:write. See [authentication](https://www.hedra.com/docs/pages/developer/v3/authentication).

For asynchronous jobs, estimate cost with POST /v3/models/{model}/estimate and use polling, server-sent events, or signed webhooks to follow completion. For chat requests, read the completion response or stream it; do not apply the model-job polling loop.

For World Model Runtime, model adaptation, and custom deployment access, see [Platform and availability](https://www.hedra.com/docs/pages/developer/v3/platform).

post.description:
Generate audio-driven avatar video from an image and audio input. Inspect this model's input schema for supported inputs and limits.

Submits an asynchronous job and returns `202` with a job id. Fetch the result at `GET /v3/jobs/{job_id}` — each item in its `outputs[]` follows the `OutputItem` schema — or track progress via `GET /v3/jobs/{job_id}/status` / the SSE stream at `GET /v3/jobs/{job_id}/stream`.

List Hedra inference jobs with limit and cursor pagination. Read each job's ID, model, quality, status, and creation time.

List Hedra API keys for a workspace. Inspect key metadata and scopes to manage credentials used by your v3 integrations.
Rotate a Hedra API key by ID. Review the rotation request and credential response before updating your integration.
Revoke a Hedra API key by ID to stop it authenticating v3 API requests. Review the required parameters and response.
Create a short-lived Hedra bearer token for client access. Narrow its scopes or set its lifetime; the response returns the token and its expiration time.
Read the prepaid USD API wallet balance for your Hedra workspace. Check available funds before making billable inference requests.
Inspect Hedra v3 API usage over a time range. Group it by day or by model to review job and sandbox spend.
Retrieve Hedra's Ed25519 public key to verify signed webhook deliveries. Use it with the signature verification steps in the webhook guide.
Read the default Hedra webhook configuration for job events and API wallet automatic top-up failure notifications.
Set or update the default Hedra webhook URL for job events and API wallet top-up failures. Enable or pause deliveries.
Remove the default Hedra webhook configuration for job and billing events. Submitted jobs can still specify a per-job webhook URL.
Send a test delivery to your default Hedra webhook endpoint. Inspect the response to check the connection before relying on job events.
List Hedra webhook deliveries and inspect their status, attempts, and outcomes. Use the results to investigate delivery failures.

Create a Hedra log drain to send job lifecycle events to your HTTPS endpoint in NDJSON or OTLP format.
Read a Hedra log drain by ID. Inspect its configuration, enabled status, and recent delivery health.
Update a Hedra log drain by ID. Change its destination, format, credentials, or enabled status using the published request fields.
Delete a Hedra log drain by ID to stop sending job lifecycle events to its destination.
Send a test batch to a Hedra log drain destination. Inspect the response to verify your log receiver configuration.
